items.title: Latest day to cancel the appointment without penalty
items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment is Monday 14.12.2026. Cancellation must reach the practice at least two Werktage (business days) before the appointment. In German usage, Werktage include Monday–Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Counting backward from the appointment day: 1 Werktag before = Saturday 12.12.2026; 2 Werktage before = Friday 11.12.2026. Neither 11.12. nor 12.12.2026 is a public holiday in NW. Therefore the cancellation must reach the practice by Friday, 11.12.2026 at the latest.
